title: 第五百六十一章 崔老还请你作主第五百六十章 该来的都已来了
content_zh:
“崔老，还请你作主！”
就在崔连科和王龙两人交谈正酣的时候，一个声音突然说道。
是赵思思，她趁着众人的注意力都集中在崔家和王龙身上的时候，出其不意挣脱王龙手下控制。
赵思思并没有逃走，因为她很清楚，这么多人的情况下，自己根本无路可逃，而且就算从街上逃掉，以王龙现在的能力，找到自己也是轻而易举的。
她必须要想一个真正解决的对策。
崔连科，这也许是她唯一的希望。
虽然她的内心，极其不情愿和崔家人有任何交集，毕竟曾经也是有过不愉快的过节的。
可是，如果被王龙带走，那自己的人生就彻底到头了。
她只能硬着头皮，跟崔连科开口了。
赵思思只说了这一句话，空气就安静了。
崔连科的目光看着她，赵思思低着头，只觉得浑身不自在，根本不敢抬头。
她本以为自己和崔永堂算了之后，再也不会和崔家有任何联系，谁曾想到，现在自己却竟然有求于崔家了。
“你想干什么？”
崔连科冷冷的说道。
“崔老，王龙杀了我爸爸，现在又想把我带走，请崔老还我一个公道。”赵思思一狠心，咬牙说道。
是啊，不管能不能有效果，必须要说了，哪怕是一根稻草，自己也要抓住。
说完，赵思思的心跳的很快。
这可是关系到自己人生结局的时刻。
只是一想到自己的人生，被王龙，崔连科这些人左右着，赵思思的心里就有一种苦涩的感觉。
“呵呵，一派胡言！”

崔连科脸色一变，冷冷说道。
赵思思的心顿时，就冷了下去。
这结果，几乎早已在她预料之中了。
“崔老，你是江阳市最有威望的人物，也是最能代表公平的大人物，还请你能主持正义！”赵思思稳了稳心神，强打起精神说道。
她的语气苦涩别扭，毕竟她从来没有说过这样恭维别人的话，但是今天为了自己的安危，也只能如此了。
她这些话看起来是夸赞，但是其实也是在提醒崔连科别忘记他自己的身份。
果然，被赵思思这么一说，崔连科似乎也意识到自己的身份了，脸上不由端庄严肃了几分。
这家伙虽然本质上不是什么好人，但是至少表面文章还是要做一做的，尤其是此时还是在公共场合，很多人看着这里呢。
“王龙先生，这到底是怎么回事？”
崔连科只能装模作样的向王龙问话。
说实话，王龙现在并不慌，一点也不慌。
从一开始赵思思说话的时候，王龙就没有慌，他怎么会害怕一个赵思思呢，所以，他并没有让人阻拦赵思思。
“哈哈，崔老，这臭丫头的话你也相信吗？事实上是这样的！”
王龙把之前在包间里说的话，又给说了一遍。
“他说谎！”
赵思思此时不能再忍了，这是自己最后的机会，“我们根本没有偷他的东西，也根本没有车祸，是他在皇津酒吧里杀了我爸爸的！”
“呵呵，想知道谁说谎，其实很简单，只要看一看死者的尸体就行了。”崔连科说道。
“我爸爸的尸体……”赵思思说到这个，心里一下子又难过无比，有那么一刻，她精神好像一下子失去了也不想再抗争了，可是，她必须要坚强起来，“我爸爸的尸体就是被他藏起来了，他心虚不敢交出来！”
content_en:
"Mr. Cui, please make the decision!"
Just when Cui Lianke and Wang Long were having a conversation, a voice suddenly said.
It was Zhao Sisi. She took advantage of everyone's attention to focus on the Cui family and Wang Long, and unexpectedly broke free from the control of Wang Long's men.
Zhao Sisi did not run away, because she knew very well that with so many people, she had no way to escape, and even if she escaped from the street, with Wang Long's current ability, it would be easy to find her.
She had to think of a real solution.
Trillenko, this may be her only hope.
Although in her heart, she was extremely reluctant to have any interaction with the Cui family, after all, she had had unpleasant experiences in the past.
However, if he is taken away by Wang Long, his life will be completely over.
She could only bite the bullet and speak to Trillenko.
Zhao Sisi only said this sentence, and the air became quiet.
Cui Lianke looked at her, and Zhao Sisi lowered her head, feeling uncomfortable all over and not daring to raise her head at all.
She originally thought that after she and Cui Yongtang were over, she would never have any contact with the Cui family again. Who would have thought that now she would actually ask for help from the Cui family.
"What do you want to do?"
Trillenko said coldly.
"Mr. Cui, Wang Long killed my father and now wants to take me away. Please give me justice, Mr. Cui." Zhao Sisi gritted her teeth and said with a cruel heart.
Yes, regardless of whether it can be effective or not, I must say that even if it is a straw, I must grasp it.
After saying that, Zhao Sisi's heart beat very fast.
This is a moment that affects the outcome of your life.
Just thinking about her life being controlled by people like Wang Long and Cui Lianke made Zhao Sisi feel a bitter feeling in her heart.
"Haha, what a load of nonsense!"
Cui Lianke's expression changed and he said coldly.
Zhao Sisi's heart suddenly became cold.
This result had almost been expected by her.
"Mr. Cui, you are the most prestigious person in Jiangyang City and the person who best represents fairness. Please be able to uphold justice!" Zhao Sisi calmed down and said with force.
Her tone was bitter and awkward. After all, she had never said such compliments to others, but for her own safety today, she had to do this.
Her words may seem like compliments, but they are actually reminding Cui Lianke not to forget his own identity.
Sure enough, after Zhao Sisi said this, Cui Lianke seemed to be aware of his identity, and his face couldn't help but look a little more dignified and serious.
Although this guy is not a good person in nature, at least he still has to do something superficial, especially when he is still in a public place with many people watching.
"Mr. Wang Long, what on earth is going on?"
Cui Lianke could only pretend to ask Wang Long.
To be honest, Wang Long is not panic now, not at all.
From the beginning when Zhao Sisi spoke, Wang Long did not panic. How could he be afraid of Zhao Sisi? Therefore, he did not let anyone stop Zhao Sisi.
"Haha, Mr. Cui, do you believe what this stinky girl says? In fact, it is like this!"
Wang Long repeated what he said in the private room before.
"He lied!"
Zhao Sisi couldn't bear it anymore. This was her last chance. "We didn't steal his things at all, and there was no car accident at all. He killed my father in the Huangjin bar!"
"Haha, if you want to know who is lying, it's actually very simple. Just look at the body of the deceased." Trillenko said.
"My father's body..." When Zhao Sisi said this, she felt extremely sad. For a moment, she seemed to have lost her spirit and no longer wanted to fight. However, she had to be strong. "My father's body was hidden by him. He felt guilty and dared not hand it over!"
